notes.title: 06.19.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]This patch applies only to the English, French, German, and Japanese versions of the game. 
This patch is associated with the following revision numbers for each game within the collection:[/p][list][*][p]LUNAR Silver Star Complete - REV:8352[/p][/*][*][p]LUNAR 2 Eternal Blue - REV:8350[/p][/*][/list][p]The revision number can be confirmed by putting either game into windowed mode and checking the number displayed at the top of the window.[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes:[/h2][p][/p][p][b]LUNAR Silver Star Story[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a phrase used in the game’s dialogue text wouldn’t display correctly.*[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several errors in the dialogue where information was incorrect/contained spoilers for future events.*[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck inside an NPC if they entered a room at a specific timing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a graphical issue where a normally off-screen area could be displayed at the top of Myght’s Tower.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]LUNAR 2 Eternal Blue[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the icons used for certain Magic were different than the original.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where text for some of the books in Gwyn's House would be displayed off-center.*[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the item description for Gauss’ Necklace, which incorrectly indicated it would restore 7 HP instead of 1.*[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the FPS performance of LUNAR 2 Eternal Blue.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]*Indicates an issue was only present in the English, French, and German versions of the game.[/p]

notes.title: English Audio Update
notes.content:
[b]Update:[/b]

The issue where each game in the collection defaulted to Japanese audio, even when English text was selected from the launcher, has now been fixed.
